<p class="skill-reference-meta"><span>Arcantry 1.0.0</span><code>$maintain-release-story</code></p>

Keep SemVer, OpenSpec release artifacts, native package versions, and consumer-facing changelog entries aligned. Use to plan, prepare, or audit a release from accepted product changes without publishing it.

## Link this skill

```text
arcantry skills link maintain-release-story --scope user
arcantry skills link maintain-release-story --scope user --agent claude
arcantry skills link maintain-release-story --scope user --agent gemini
```

The default target is the Codex-compatible Agent Skills directory. Use the explicit agent profile for Claude Code or Gemini CLI.

## Compatibility

Source kinds: `openspec`, `changelog`.

## Learning outcomes

- Derive release impact and consumer-facing notes from accepted OpenSpec release artifacts.
- Verify one version across release manifests and native package metadata.

## Examples

### Prepare a product release

**Prompt**

> Use $maintain-release-story to prepare the next release from completed OpenSpec changes without publishing it.

**Expected outcome**

A verified release set aligns SemVer, manifests, components, and consumer-facing changelog entries.

### Audit release consistency

**Prompt**

> Use $maintain-release-story to check whether package versions and release notes match the accepted product changes.

**Expected outcome**

Version or release-story drift is reported with its authoritative source and exact repair boundary.
